title: Du‘a in Salah
intro: The du‘a after Salah from our book – praise, asking Allah to accept, and asking for good in both worlds.

learn.html: After we finish Salah, we raise our hands and make du‘a. In our book this du‘a has five parts. Learn its words and, just as important, what they mean – then you will really be talking to Allah.

learn.label: Part 1 – seeking refuge and Bismillah
learn.ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
learn.en: I seek refuge with Allah from Shaytan, the accursed. In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

learn.label: Part 2 – praise and salawat
learn.ar: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ أَجْمَعِينَ
learn.tr: Alhamdu lillaahi rabbil-‘aalameen. Was-salaatu was-salaamu ‘alaa sayyidinaa Muhammadin wa ‘alaa aalihee wa sahbihee ajma‘een.
learn.en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Blessings and peace be upon our master Muhammad, and upon all his family and companions.

learn.label: Part 3 – accept our Salah
learn.ar: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلْ مِنَّا هَٰذِهِ الصَّلَاةَ كَمَا تَقَبَّلْتَ مِنْ عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا الْإِيمَانَ وَالْإِسْلَامَ وَالْإِحْسَانَ، وَكَرِّهْ إِلَيْنَا الْكُفْرَ وَالْفُسُوقَ وَالْعِصْيَانَ
learn.tr: Allaahumma rabbanaa taqabbal minnaa haadhihis-salaata kamaa taqabbalta min ‘ibaadikas-saaliheen. Allaahumma habbib ilaynal-eemaana wal-islaama wal-ihsaana, wa karrih ilaynal-kufra wal-fusooqa wal-‘isyaan.
learn.en: O Allah, our Lord, accept this prayer from us as You accepted it from Your righteous servants. O Allah, make faith, Islam and doing good (ihsan) dear to us, and make disbelief, wickedness and disobedience hateful to us.

learn.label: Part 4 – good in both worlds
learn.ar: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ، رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِنْ ذُرِّيَّتِي، رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَاءِ، رَبَّنَا اغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ الْحِسَابُ، بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِينَ
learn.tr: Rabbanaa aatinaa fid-dunyaa hasanatan wa fil-aakhirati hasanatan wa qinaa ‘adhaaban-naar. Rabbij‘alnee muqeemas-salaati wa min dhurriyyatee, rabbanaa wa taqabbal du‘aa’. Rabbanaghfir lee wa li-waalidayya wa lil-mu’mineena yawma yaqoomul-hisaab, bi-rahmatika yaa arhamar-raahimeen.
learn.en: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire. My Lord, make me one who keeps up the prayer, and my children too. Our Lord, accept my du‘a. Our Lord, forgive me, my parents and the believers on the Day of Reckoning – by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of all.

learn.label: Part 5 – the ending
learn.ar: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ الْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ، وَسَلَامٌ عَلَى الْمُرْسَلِينَ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ
learn.tr: Subhaana rabbika rabbil-‘izzati ‘ammaa yasifoon, wa salaamun ‘alal-mursaleen, wal-hamdu lillaahi rabbil-‘aalameen.
learn.en: Glory be to your Lord, the Lord of Honour, far above what they say about Him. Peace be upon the messengers, and praise be to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

learn.title: 💡 Did you notice?
learn.html: Parts 4 and 5 are du‘as from the Qur’an: the du‘a for good in both worlds <small>(Al-Baqarah 2:201)</small>, the du‘a of Prophet Ibrahim (AS) for himself, his children and his parents <small>(Ibrahim 14:40–41)</small>, and the ending of Surah As-Saffat <small>(As-Saffat 37:180–182)</small>.
Practise the du‘as of Salah: At-Tahiyyatu, Salawat and Duas.

practice.title: The du‘a in order
practice.prompt: Put the parts of the du‘a in order.

practice.title: What do we ask for?
practice.prompt: Tap everything we ask Allah for in this du‘a, then tap Check.

options.text: To make faith dear to us
Good in this world and the Hereafter
Forgiveness for us, our parents and the believers

options.why: That is not in this du‘a – we ask for good in both worlds.

practice.title: Talk with your muallim
prompts: 🎧 Learn the du‘a part by part and recite it after your next Salah.
💬 Which part is about your parents? Why do you think we ask Allah to forgive them too?
